articles.summary: Companies moving at the speed of AI require power at the speed of AI, and they are increasingly taking matters into their own hands, Bloom Energy’s 2026 Data Center Power Report reveals. They are choosing new geographies where time to power is shorter and bringing in onsite power to meet their needs.
articles.title: Onsite Power, New Geographies Will Dominate Data Center Market by 2028

articles.summary: Bloom Energy, a global leader in onsite power solutions, today announced the appointment of Simon Edwards as Chief Financial Officer, effective April 13, 2026.
articles.title: Bloom Energy Appoints Simon Edwards as Chief Financial Officer

articles.summary: It can take years for a new facility to connect to grid power, due to planning, permitting, and transmission construction timelines.
articles.title: Time to Power: The New Competitive Advantage for Manufacturers
